text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's annual summer training 
camp had arrived. Narita Brian, who had 
skipped the Tenno Sho (Spring) due to 
injury, was also participating in the 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Marvelous Sunday and Mayano Top Gun 
seemed excited to run against Narita Brian 
now that she had made her comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel was the sole person watching 
Narita Brian's state with a solemn 
expression upon her face.
